paragraphs.text: בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לְצֵ֥את בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֔ה בָּ֖אוּ מִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

i18n.en: In the third month after the children of Yisra'el had gone out from the land of Mitsrayim, on that same day they came to the wilderness of Sinai.

paragraphs.commentary: Arrival at the wilderness of Sinai 'on that same day' (*ba-yyôm ha-zzeh*) — the exact Sivan-1 reading is a documented rabbinic tradition (b. Shabbat 86b) supporting the Pentecost-as-Sinai theological identification.

paragraphs.text: וַיִּסְע֣וּ מֵרְפִידִ֗ים וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ מִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וַֽיַּחֲנ֖וּ בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיִּֽחַן־שָׁ֥ם יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נֶ֥גֶד הָהָֽר׃

i18n.en: And they journeyed from Refidim and came to the wilderness of Sinai, and they camped in the wilderness; and Yisra'el camped there before the mountain.

paragraphs.text: וּמֹשֶׁ֥ה עָלָ֖ה אֶל־הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ מִן־הָהָ֣ר לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֤ה תֹאמַר֙ לְבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתַגֵּ֖יד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

i18n.en: And Moses went up to the Elohim, and YHWH called to him from the mountain, saying, "Thus you shall say to the house of Ya'aqov, and tell the children of Yisra'el:

paragraphs.commentary: Moses' first ascent to *hā-ʾĕlōhîm*; YHWH calls *min-hā-hār* 'from the mountain' — establishing the mountain-as-divine-residence/theophany-site register.

paragraphs.text: אַתֶּ֣ם רְאִיתֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי לְמִצְרָ֑יִם וָאֶשָּׂ֤א אֶתְכֶם֙ עַל־כַּנְפֵ֣י נְשָׁרִ֔ים וָאָבִ֥א אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֵלָֽי׃

i18n.en: 'You yourselves have seen what I did to Mitsrayim, and how I bore you on eagles' wings and brought you to myself.

paragraphs.commentary: *ʿal-kanp̄ê nĕšārîm* 'on eagles' wings' — the *nešer* lexeme covers both 'eagle' and 'griffon-vulture' in Hebrew biological-classification (Sarna 1991 ad loc.; the modern critical literature documents the *nešer* as more probably 'griffon-vulture' on the basis of the bird's behavior at Job 39:27-30, Mic 1:16). The WoH-Translation preserves 'eagles' wings' per the dominant English-translation tradition.

paragraphs.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה אִם־שָׁמ֤וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְעוּ֙ בְּקֹלִ֔י וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֑י וִהְיִ֨יתֶם לִ֤י סְגֻלָּה֙ מִכָּל־הָ֣עַמִּ֔ים כִּי־לִ֖י כָּל־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

i18n.en: And now, if you will surely listen to my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my treasured possession out of all the peoples — for all the earth is mine —

paragraphs.commentary: **The covenantal-formula initiation**: *wi-hyiyṯem lî sĕgullâ mi-kkol hā-ʿammîm* 'you shall be my treasured-possession from among all the peoples'. The *sĕgullâ* lexeme has Akkadian cognate-evidence: *sikiltu* 'private-treasure / personal-valuable'. See the central entry `segullah-mamleḵet-kohanim-vegoy-qadosh-covenantal-formula-ex-19-5-6-cross-corpus`. The conditional *ʾim* 'if' grammar is preserved.

paragraphs.text: וְאַתֶּ֧ם תִּהְיוּ־לִ֛י מַמְלֶ֥כֶת כֹּהֲנִ֖ים וְג֣וֹי קָד֑וֹשׁ אֵ֚לֶּה הַדְּבָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּדַבֵּ֖ר אֶל־בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

i18n.en: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.' These are the words that you shall speak to the children of Yisra'el."

paragraphs.commentary: *mamleḵeṯ kōhănîm wĕ-gôy qāḏôš* 'a kingdom of priests and a holy nation'. Cross-corpus to Deut 7:6, 14:2, 26:18; Ps 135:4; 1 Pet 2:9 (the NT reapplication); Rev 1:6, 5:10. The central entry documents the disavowal against Christian-supersessionist 'Israel-replaced-by-Church' pre-resolution and against 'Israel = engineered-elect-race' Raëlian-canon reading.

paragraphs.text: וַיָּבֹ֣א מֹשֶׁ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א לְזִקְנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַיָּ֣שֶׂם לִפְנֵיהֶ֗ם אֵ֚ת כָּל־הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖הוּ יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And Moses came and called for the elders of the people and set before them all these words which YHWH had commanded him.

paragraphs.text: וַיַּעֲנ֨וּ כָל־הָעָ֤ם יַחְדָּו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲשֶׂ֑ה וַיָּ֧שֶׁב מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And all the people answered together and said, "All that YHWH has spoken we will do." And Moses brought back the words of the people to YHWH.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה הִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י בָּ֣א אֵלֶיךָ֮ בְּעַ֣ב הֶֽעָנָן֒ בַּעֲב֞וּר יִשְׁמַ֤ע הָעָם֙ בְּדַבְּרִ֣י עִמָּ֔ךְ וְגַם־בְּךָ֖ יַאֲמִ֣ינוּ לְעוֹלָ֑ם וַיַּגֵּ֥ד מֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶת־דִּבְרֵ֥י הָעָ֖ם אֶל־יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "Behold, I am coming to you in a thick cloud, so that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also trust in you forever." And Moses told the words of the people to YHWH.

paragraphs.commentary: *ʾānōḵî bāʾ ʾēleḵā bĕ-ʿaḇ he-ʿānān* 'I am coming to you in a thick cloud' — the cloud-theophany announcement-formula. See the central entry `sinai-theophany-ex-19-elohim-craft-descent-disavowals-volcanic-hypothesis-cross-corpus`.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁה֙ לֵ֣ךְ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ם הַיּ֖וֹם וּמָחָ֑ר וְכִבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "Go to the people and consecrate them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments.

paragraphs.text: וְהָי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כִּ֣י ׀ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֗י יֵרֵ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה לְעֵינֵ֥י כָל־הָעָ֖ם עַל־הַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

i18n.en: And let them be ready for the third day, for on the third day YHWH will come down before the eyes of all the people on Mount Sinai.

paragraphs.commentary: YHWH's third-day descent on Mount Sinai *lĕ-ʿênê ḵol-hā-ʿām* 'before the eyes of all the people' — the public-theophany framing.

paragraphs.text: וְהִגְבַּלְתָּ֤ אֶת־הָעָם֙ סָבִ֣יב לֵאמֹ֔ר הִשָּׁמְר֥וּ לָכֶ֛ם עֲל֥וֹת בָּהָ֖ר וּנְגֹ֣עַ בְּקָצֵ֑הוּ כָּל־הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהָ֖ר מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃

i18n.en: And you shall set bounds for the people round about, saying, 'Take heed for yourselves not to go up into the mountain or to touch its edge; whoever touches the mountain shall surely be put to death.

paragraphs.text: לֹא־תִגַּ֨ע בּ֜וֹ יָ֗ד כִּֽי־סָק֤וֹל יִסָּקֵל֙ אוֹ־יָרֹ֣ה יִיָּרֶ֔ה אִם־בְּהֵמָ֥ה אִם־אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֣א יִחְיֶ֑ה בִּמְשֹׁךְ֙ הַיֹּבֵ֔ל הֵ֖מָּה יַעֲל֥וּ בָהָֽר׃

i18n.en: No hand shall touch him, for he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether animal or man, he shall not live.' When the ram's horn sounds a long blast, they may go up to the mountain."

paragraphs.commentary: *bi-mšōḵ ha-yōḇēl* 'when the ram's horn sounds a long blast' — the *yōḇēl* lexeme distinguished from the more-general *šōp̄ār* (vv 16, 19); see the overlay entry. The yōḇēl-Jubilee thematic-connection (Lev 25:9-13).

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּ֧רֶד מֹשֶׁ֛ה מִן־הָהָ֖ר אֶל־הָעָ֑ם וַיְקַדֵּשׁ֙ אֶת־הָעָ֔ם וַֽיְכַבְּס֖וּ שִׂמְלֹתָֽם׃

i18n.en: And Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and consecrated the people; and they washed their garments.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־הָעָ֔ם הֱי֥וּ נְכֹנִ֖ים לִשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֑ים אַֽל־תִּגְּשׁ֖וּ אֶל־אִשָּֽׁה׃

i18n.en: And he said to the people, "Be ready for the third day; do not approach a woman."

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִי֩ בַיּ֨וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י בִּֽהְיֹ֣ת הַבֹּ֗קֶר וַיְהִי֩ קֹלֹ֨ת וּבְרָקִ֜ים וְעָנָ֤ן כָּבֵד֙ עַל־הָהָ֔ר וְקֹ֥ל שֹׁפָ֖ר חָזָ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־הָעָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּֽמַּחֲנֶֽה׃

i18n.en: And it came to pass on the third day, when the morning came, that there were thunders and lightnings, and a heavy cloud upon the mountain, and the sound of a shofar exceedingly loud; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

paragraphs.commentary: **THE SINAI THEOPHANY climax-verse.** *qōlōṯ ū-ḇĕrāqîm wĕ-ʿānān kāḇēḏ ʿal-hā-hār wĕ-qōl šōp̄ār ḥāzāq mĕʾōḏ* 'thunders and lightnings, and a heavy cloud upon the mountain, and the sound of a shofar exceedingly loud'. The Exodus-distinctive cloud-fire-thunder-trumpet-blast compositional cluster (overlay entry); the broader divine-self-revelation theophany (central entry). The *qōlōṯ* 'thunders' renders the Hebrew *qôl* in the standard theophanic register (cf. Ps 29); the synaesthesia *rōʾîm ʾeṯ-ha-qōlōṯ* 'seeing the thunders' (Ex 20:18) reactivates the same lexeme. **Acknowledgment-without-endorsement of the Raëlian-canon's engagement** — *Extra-Terrestrials Took Me To Their Planet* engages this verse as the canon's most-explicit 'Elohim-craft descent on the mountain' citation — per the Shi'ur Qomah parasangs precedent and the Qur'an *inshiqāq al-qamar* precedent. The WoH-Translation does NOT adopt the canon's framing on the surface; the lens-discipline rides entirely in the apparatus.

paragraphs.text: וַיּוֹצֵ֨א מֹשֶׁ֧ה אֶת־הָעָ֛ם לִקְרַ֥את הָֽאֱלֹהִ֖ים מִן־הַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ בְּתַחְתִּ֥ית הָהָֽר׃

i18n.en: And Moses brought the people out of the camp to meet the Elohim, and they stood at the foot of the mountain.

paragraphs.commentary: Moses brings the people to meet *hā-ʾĕlōhîm* at the foot of the mountain (*tachtit hā-hār*) — the cultic-architectural staging of the theophany.

paragraphs.text: וְהַ֤ר סִינַי֙ עָשַׁ֣ן כֻּלּ֔וֹ מִ֠פְּנֵי אֲשֶׁ֨ר יָרַ֥ד עָלָ֛יו יְהוָ֖ה בָּאֵ֑שׁ וַיַּ֤עַל עֲשָׁנוֹ֙ כְּעֶ֣שֶׁן הַכִּבְשָׁ֔ן וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד כָּל־הָהָ֖ר מְאֹֽד׃

i18n.en: And Mount Sinai was wholly in smoke, because YHWH had come down upon it in fire; and its smoke went up like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain trembled exceedingly.

paragraphs.commentary: *wĕ-har sînay ʿāšan kullô mip-pĕnê ʾăšer yāraḏ ʿālāyw YHWH bā-ʾēš* 'and Mount Sinai was wholly in smoke, because YHWH had come down upon it in fire'. The mountain-on-fire imagery; the simile *kĕ-ʿešen ha-kkiḇšān* 'like the smoke of a furnace' has cross-corpus echo at Gen 19:28 (the Sodom-Gomorrah destruction). The volcanic-Sinai academic-historical hypothesis (Stade, Wellhausen, Gressmann, Phythian-Adams, Humphreys 2003) is preserved as a documented academic-historical hypothesis without adjudication; see the central entry.

paragraphs.text: וַיְהִי֙ ק֣וֹל הַשּׁוֹפָ֔ר הוֹלֵ֖ךְ וְחָזֵ֣ק מְאֹ֑ד מֹשֶׁ֣ה יְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהָאֱלֹהִ֖ים יַעֲנֶ֥נּוּ בְקֽוֹל׃

i18n.en: And the sound of the shofar grew louder and louder; Moses spoke, and the Elohim answered him by a voice.

paragraphs.commentary: The continued shofar-blast intensification; *hā-ʾĕlōhîm yaʿănennû bĕ-qōl* 'the Elohim answered him by a voice' — the Sinai-theophany dialogue-mediation.

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּ֧רֶד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־הַ֥ר סִינַ֖י אֶל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָהָ֑ר וַיִּקְרָ֨א יְהוָ֧ה לְמֹשֶׁ֛ה אֶל־רֹ֥אשׁ הָהָ֖ר וַיַּ֥עַל מֹשֶֽׁה׃

i18n.en: And YHWH came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain; and YHWH called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

paragraphs.commentary: *wa-yyēreḏ YHWH ʿal-har sînay* 'YHWH came down on Mount Sinai' — the explicit descent-formula. The Moses-up / YHWH-down-summit meeting establishes the prophetic-mediator institutional grounding.

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה רֵ֖ד הָעֵ֣ד בָּעָ֑ם פֶּן־יֶהֶרְס֤וּ אֶל־יְהוָה֙ לִרְא֔וֹת וְנָפַ֥ל מִמֶּ֖נּוּ רָֽב׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to Moses, "Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to YHWH to look, and many of them fall.

paragraphs.text: וְגַ֧ם הַכֹּהֲנִ֛ים הַנִּגָּשִׁ֥ים אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה יִתְקַדָּ֑שׁוּ פֶּן־יִפְרֹ֥ץ בָּהֶ֖ם יְהוָֽה׃

i18n.en: And let the priests also, who come near to YHWH, consecrate themselves, lest YHWH break out against them."

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר מֹשֶׁה֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה לֹא־יוּכַ֣ל הָעָ֔ם לַעֲלֹ֖ת אֶל־הַ֣ר סִינָ֑י כִּֽי־אַתָּ֞ה הַעֵדֹ֤תָה בָּ֙נוּ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַגְבֵּ֥ל אֶת־הָהָ֖ר וְקִדַּשְׁתּֽוֹ׃

i18n.en: And Moses said to YHWH, "The people are not able to come up to Mount Sinai, for you yourself warned us, saying, 'Set bounds around the mountain and consecrate it.'"

paragraphs.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלָ֤יו יְהוָה֙ לֶךְ־רֵ֔ד וְעָלִ֥יתָ אַתָּ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן עִמָּ֑ךְ וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְהָעָ֗ם אַל־יֶֽהֶרְס֛וּ לַעֲלֹ֥ת אֶל־יְהוָ֖ה פֶּן־יִפְרָץ־בָּֽם׃

i18n.en: And YHWH said to him, "Go, get down, and you shall come up — you and Aharon with you; but let not the priests and the people break through to come up to YHWH, lest he break out against them."

paragraphs.text: וַיֵּ֥רֶד מֹשֶׁ֖ה אֶל־הָעָ֑ם וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אֲלֵהֶֽם׃ (ס)

i18n.en: And Moses went down to the people and spoke to them.
